//: Copy this file to config.json and fill in your values, then run query-helper.ps1.
//workspaceId: Log Analytics workspace GUID (customerId), e.g. from: az monitor log-analytics workspace show --query customerId
//timeRangeHours: Lookback window for both queries, in hours. 168 = 7 days.
//rateCardCsv: Path to the effective-dated rate card used to price tokens (see aoai-no-gateway/03-pricing-table.sample.csv). Never commit real contract prices.
//enrichmentTable: OPTIONAL. Custom-table name the portal prefers for department/app/user + all meters. Defaults to AiSpendEnrichment_CL. Remove or leave as-is if you have not wired the enrichment pipeline; the portal falls back to the platform + gateway logs.
